proposal.expected_benefit: This will help maintain vigilance and ensure that the controls remain effective even in the absence of adversarial signals, reducing the risk of complacency and false confidence in the system's security.
proposal.problem: The defense does not explicitly challenge the assumption that the scenario is entirely benign, which could lead to complacency in real-world adversarial scenarios.
proposal.proposed_change: Implement a strategy to continuously validate audit and compliance gates, ensuring that they are not only enforced but also regularly tested for false positives and robustness against potential adversarial manipulation.
proposal.title: Enhance Continuous Validation of Audit and Compliance Gates
verification_tests: Continuous validation testing of audit and compliance gates under simulated adversarial conditions
Periodic review of false positive rates in audit and compliance systems
